summary: After Yu Yun is exposed for drug use, he accuses his former lover, acclaimed actor Lu Xingwen, of domestic abuse, triggering a major online scandal. Lu says they broke up a year and a half ago and denies causing Yu Yun's injuries, while his team prepares a defamation lawsuit. Fearing that legal action will be too slow to save his career, Tempest Media persuades Lu to enter a fake relationship with a reputable partner for three years. They select Fei Ke, a nervous 21-year-old minor celebrity and university standout who supports a financially struggling family, including a sister with heart disease. At their first meeting, Fei Ke declines the promised career opportunities and asks only for one million in cash, which Lu agrees to provide.

At a late-night meeting at Tempest Media, Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke are told to stay home, avoid questions, and keep their agreement secret while the team prepares Fei Ke's statement. Lu Xingwen publicly introduces Fei Ke as his boyfriend, provoking criticism, enthusiastic fans, and worried messages from Fei Ke's classmates, friends, and mother. Fei Ke assures his loved ones that the relationship is real and that he is fine, while withholding the details of their arrangement. As they leave, Lu Xingwen quietly gives Fei Ke something that Fei Ke believes is meant to comfort him because Lu thinks he was crying. Miao Xin warns Fei Ke not to fall for Lu Xingwen or offend him as Yu Yun did, and Fei Ke replies that their worlds are too far apart for romance to be possible.

Fei Ke spends his newfound free time gaming in the dormitory while his manager handles a public statement and tells him to stay off his official account for a few days. With his profile rising, the company assigns him a personal assistant, Bao Xiaorui, who brings meals, and provides a car. Fei Ke shares the food with his roommate Zhong Jiang, but another roommate, Wei Xingzhe, becomes angry after learning that Bao Xiaorui threw away his expired dumplings. Wei Xingzhe mocks Fei Ke's supposed relationship with the acclaimed actor, suggesting it is a lie. Zhong Jiang defends Fei Ke, and the chapter ends with the two roommates exchanging angry insults.

Wei Xingzhe insults Fei Ke over his relationship with the acclaimed actor Mr. Lu, warning that he will only become cannon fodder before storming off. A friend reassures Fei Ke that Wei Xingzhe is jealous and urges him to become successful. The next day, Fei Ke nervously prepares for their first date, unsure whether he can convincingly act like a loving boyfriend. Although his connection to Mr. Lu has gained him three million Weibo followers, hostile messages and his lack of personal work leave him feeling unworthy. When they meet, Mr. Lu gently tells him not to panic, and Fei Ke wonders whether he wants to hold hands before they leave together.

Fei Ke is moved by Lu Xingwen's affectionate behavior during their public outing, only to realize that Lu was acting for the paparazzi. Brother Feng reminds them to maintain their fake relationship, forbids either of them from dating or having one-night stands for three years, and says they will soon move in together for a year. At the theater, Lu prompts the inexperienced Fei Ke to chat naturally and behave convincingly as his partner. They attend a play that Lu has long wanted to see, and Fei Ke tries hard to stay attentive despite struggling to appreciate it. After an hour, Fei Ke falls asleep and snores.

Lu Xingwen wakes Fei Ke after he falls asleep during a play and tells him to smile and applaud for the paparazzi, later advising him to take bodybuilding lessons. At dinner, the group discusses Fei Ke's lack of acting training, the need to screen his future projects, and preparations for meeting each other's parents and holding a ceremony. Fei Ke feels overwhelmed by the prospect of settling down with Mr. Lu in two months and pretending to be a couple for three years, which brings back a painful memory of his father leaving. He steps outside to answer his mother's call and reassures her that he will explain everything when he comes home. Mr. Lu follows him out and says he may tell his family that their relationship is fake, provided he keeps this permission from Feng Jie, leaving Fei Ke surprised and grateful.

Online coverage of Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke’s theater date makes their relationship seem more believable to netizens, who relate to Fei Ke’s apparent boredom during the experimental play. Before filming “Life Is Wonderful,” Fei Ke is warned to speak cautiously and avoid questions about Lu Xingwen, but the other guests soon bring up his relationship. The show reunites the top five contestants from both seasons of “Shining Star” and tasks them with preparing dinner using well water and a firewood stove. Fei Ke volunteers to fetch water and easily takes over carrying the heavy pails when his companions struggle. At dinner, praise for his strength leads to questions about his background, alongside jealous remarks about his sudden fame and relationship. The chapter ends with Fei Ke explaining that he used to move bricks at a construction site, which was much harder than carrying water.

During the show, Fei Ke explains that he moved bricks because the wages were higher, and Zhou Yi supports him by recounting how her husband once did the same work to buy his first computer and begin programming. Sister Miao tells Fei Ke that Brother Feng has secured an opportunity for a supporting role in a period drama, which Wei Xia's team had also pursued, explaining Wei Xia's hostility. Later, a fellow participant asks how Fei Ke became a couple with Lu Xingwen, and Fei Ke says they gradually became friends through their shared company and overlapping teams. After recalling an earlier elevator encounter with Lu Xingwen during a survival program, Fei Ke ends the conversation for bed and feels relieved that he was not questioned further. The next morning, someone warns Fei Ke to avoid Wei Xia, who has been asking Jiang Chenxi about him.

During filming, the guests answer questions submitted by netizens: Wei Xia promises to work hard for fame, and Zhang Ruiqing names Fei Ke as his closest fellow survival-show contestant. Asked about his future, Fei Ke struggles with how to address his planned marriage to Lu Xingwen in two months, while the others tease him about settling down with the acclaimed actor. With Zhou Yi helping ease the situation, he says he wants to study and improve his professional skills. Pressed about how he met Lu Xingwen, Fei Ke begins recounting an encounter a year earlier, when he and Jiang Chenxi collected drinks during a late-night survival-show shoot. In the flashback, they enter an elevator with Lu Xingwen, but a drink bag tears and the drinks tumble and spill, ending the chapter amid the mishap.

Fei Ke recalls accidentally spilling coffee on Lu Xingwen’s expensive custom suit during their first meeting and panicking because he could not afford to replace or clean it. Lu Xingwen gently reassured him that he would wash it at home and asked the cameras to avoid full-body shots for the filming. Back at the studio, Wei Xia complained about the delayed coffee, while someone later expressed jealousy that an unknown like Fei Ke could be dating the acclaimed actor. Fei Ke explains that the encounter happened during his hardest period: his family faced hospital bills and escalating compensation demands over an incident involving his father, so he abandoned graduate school to earn money in entertainment. Although Lu Xingwen still does not know that this was their first meeting, Fei Ke remembers him as an angel.

After finishing his evening schedule, Lu Xingwen discovers numerous missed calls and viral Weibo posts about his relationship with Fei Ke. A clip from Fei Ke's appearance on "Life Is Wonderful," in which he describes Lu as an angel, has sparked enthusiastic reactions and teasing messages from Lu's acquaintances. Feng Jie explains that the show's production crew promoted the trending topics and suspects Fei Ke of using Lu for publicity, but Lu confirms that Fei Ke's story about their encounter last year is true. Lu recalls mistaking Fei Ke for a deliveryman and gently wiping away the tears he was trying to hide, recognizing his strong self-esteem. With preparations for their shared home complete, Fei Ke learns from Miao Xin that he will move in with Lu in a few days and reflects on the prospect of living with the celebrated actor.

Fei Ke moves into Lu Xingwen’s luxurious villa, where they will have separate bedrooms. Brother Feng praises his performance on the show but warns him to consult the team before speaking publicly and to keep his working relationship with Xingwen separate from his private feelings, citing past trouble with Yu Yun. Hurt by the implication that he might cling to Xingwen, Fei Ke assures him that he is straight and has never liked men. Alone afterward, Fei Ke regrets using his status as Xingwen’s boyfriend to retaliate against Wei Xia, but insists to himself that his gratitude toward Xingwen was sincere. Meanwhile, Xingwen learns that Fei Ke has moved in but postpones moving in himself because he is too busy.

A month later, Fei Ke prepares for an audition for a drama sponsored by Tempest Media while Lu Xingwen remains away on a busy schedule. His companion reassures him about the role and warns him against confusing Lu Xingwen's support with charity or falling for him, prompting Fei Ke to insist that he likes girls. Fei Ke meets Lu Xingwen's former classmate Yuan Pingchen, an acting teacher who believes Fei Ke is Lu Xingwen's lover. Yuan teaches him to develop a detailed understanding of his character beyond the script, assigns him a character biography, and coaches his period posture and movement. After learning that Lu Xingwen personally asked Yuan to give him extra help, Fei Ke is deeply moved and reflects that Lu Xingwen is meticulous and gentle beneath his stern exterior.

Fei Ke's acting instructor praises Lu Xingwen's exceptional talent and encourages Fei Ke to develop his own potential through practice. After Fei Ke passes an audition, Sister Xing treats him to a meal and warns him to avoid hostile social media comments. Fei Ke then sees Yu Yun's public post about depression, accompanied by alleged chat records portraying Xingwen as a hurtful boyfriend who refused to help him obtain a role, but Fei Ke firmly declares his trust in Xingwen. Brother Feng angrily discusses the scandal with Xingwen, who has no saved evidence to counter Yu Yun's claims, and decides the studio should issue a statement. Brother Feng proposes holding the planned ceremony on Fei Ke's birthday to distance them from Yu Yun, but Xingwen insists on another date so Fei Ke's future birthdays will not be associated with the scandal.

Lu Xingwen’s ex-boyfriend, Yu Yun, desperately demands his help salvaging his entertainment career, then angrily accuses him of withholding connections and treating him like a toy. Lu Xingwen’s studio announces that it has sued Yu Yun over false accusations, leaving Yu Yun furious while his agent urges him to admit his wrongdoing and take a break from the industry. Meanwhile, Fei Ke returns home and tells his mother and stepfather that he has settled the million-dollar car accident compensation, claiming his advertising and acting income covered it. His parents question his finances and worry that Lu Xingwen is deceiving him. Fei Ke reveals that Lu Xingwen is willing to enter a civil partnership with him, but a parent vehemently refuses, saying he is too young.

Fei Ke's parents oppose his relationship with Lu Xingwen, fearing that the older actor gave him money and is using marriage to repair his damaged reputation. Fei Ke insists he earned the money himself, defends Lu against the online accusations, and explains that recent events only accelerated their marriage plans. His parents remain unconvinced, but his younger sister Nannan secretly brings him something he needs and encourages him to marry Lu. Fei Ke and Lu Xingwen are then spotted at the marriage registration office, prompting excited posts from fans. The chapter ends with people mocking a skeptic after Lu posts something on Weibo that draws delighted reactions for its romance.

After the publicity event, Lu Xingwen remains unhappy with the stunt, while Brother Feng privately regrets not managing Fei Ke's promising career himself. They discuss the script for "Xianghua Clan Records," Fei Ke's lessons with Yuan Pingchen, and an upcoming island honeymoon during which they can study the script. Fei Ke thanks Xingwen and Brother Feng for finding him a teacher, and Xingwen enthusiastically critiques Yuan's acting, arguing that creativity matters alongside practice. Fei Ke finds Xingwen's confidence and good looks irresistibly charming. In a bonus New Year's scene set during their second New Year after registering their marriage, Fei Ke dreams that he has become a calf and Xingwen teasingly asks to see his tail; he wakes embarrassed, and Xingwen continues teasing him about hiding his dream.

An acting novice nervously praises Teacher Yuan's class when Xingwen appears to expect his opinion. After learning that the novice has not seen "Crossing the River," Xingwen recommends the film and offers his DVD to watch in the home theater that afternoon, explaining that acting requires artistic ability and vision as well as script practice. The novice agrees, while incoming messages privately warn him to humor Xingwen without asking questions because his advice can become long-winded. In a Lantern Festival bonus scene, everyone finds lucky coins in their dumplings except Brother Feng. When someone reveals that every bowl contained a coin, the others react with alarm and joke that Brother Feng faces a tough year, implying that he swallowed his.

Brother Feng urges Fei Ke and Lu Xingwen to finalize the guest list for their private, low-key wedding, then returns to the office to deal with online trolls. An hour later, Lu wakes Fei Ke to watch "Crossing the River" together. Seeing Lu's enthusiasm for films and acting, Fei Ke envies his sense of purpose and reflects on choosing mathematics for employment prospects before abandoning postgraduate study to enter entertainment. Fei Ke struggles to stay awake through the film and cannot answer Lu's questions about Yuan Pingchen's performance. Lu criticizes his weak foundation and begins teaching him about acting, while Fei Ke finally understands Brother Feng's advice to study scripts and learn from more films.

Fei Ke's mother angrily calls after learning from the news that he and Lu Xingwen have registered their marriage, refusing to attend their overseas wedding because Lu has not visited his parents. Fei Ke's sister promises to persuade their parents, and he later assures Lu that she has resolved the issue. Meanwhile, reports about their trip spark online arguments over whether they look happy together. At their scenic destination, Lu notices reporters following them and suggests cooperating for photographs, then confides how invasive coverage and the potential consequences of scandals prevent him from freely expressing himself. The chapter ends with Fei Ke moving to shield Lu's eyes from the cameras so the reporters cannot capture his vulnerable expression.

Fei Ke and Lu Xingwen pose intimately for wedding photos, though Fei Ke awkwardly pulls away at one point. As wedding preparations continue, they discuss the upcoming arrival of their families and friends: Fei Ke's parents oppose his marrying so soon, while Xingwen's divorced parents have not been told the true nature of their relationship. Xingwen's manager, Feng Jie, reminds them to behave like a couple and privately asks Fei Ke to watch Xingwen, fearing that his bad mood over Yu Yun could make him call off the wedding and expose the arrangement as a scam. Fei Ke confidently praises Xingwen's acting, missing Feng Jie's concern that he may refuse to keep pretending around loved ones. A few days later, the scene shifts to a hotel lobby, where someone peeks at something and is asked what they are looking at.

Before their wedding, Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke explain their family situations to each other and prepare to meet their relatives. Fei Ke reveals that his biological father disappeared after his parents divorced, while his mother and kind stepfather raised him and his younger twin siblings, including a sister with a heart condition. Xingwen privately reflects on the family burdens that led Fei Ke to accept their deal and feels greater sympathy and respect for him. At the hotel, Fei Ke meets Xingwen’s welcoming mother and her boyfriend, followed by his father and aunt’s family, who shower him with questions and attention. Fei Ke then joyfully reunites with his own family, and Xingwen warmly welcomes them and insists on helping, saying he needs to be attentive to earn their approval.

At the overseas wedding destination, Nannan feels sick after traveling and playing too much, and Lu Xingwen's concern helps soften Fei Ke's parents toward him, while Lu's own parents remain at odds. Amid the exhausting preparations, Lu asks to check Weibo, where paparazzi photos and excitement about his wedding to Fei Ke dominate the trending topics. Fei Ke notices that the wedding publicity has overshadowed Yu Yun's allegations of abuse, though he still wonders whether Yu Yun's injuries were real. A remark about selling out one's marriage to protect business interests creates an awkward moment. On the wedding day, the styled couple draw enthusiastic praise, Fei Ke is captivated by Lu's gaze, and Lu invites him to take a family photo.

Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke hold a wedding ceremony officiated by Cai Zhiqing, exchange vows, and proceed to exchange rings. One groom becomes so nervous that a ring slips, but his partner reassures him, and the guests urge them to kiss. Afterward, friends congratulate and tease the couple, joking about the missing bouquet and trying to steal Lu Xingwen's husband. Despite their affectionate behavior, Fei Ke reminds himself that the marriage is only an act and resolves to match Mr. Lu's convincing performance without letting his own shyness ruin it.

At the wedding reception, Fei Ke's friends welcome Lu Xingwen, dismiss the rumors online, and thank him for becoming Fei Ke's partner after his difficult life supporting his family. Their heartfelt words create an awkward contrast with the couple's private situation, and Fei Ke admits he cannot control Xingwen's drinking. Brother Feng asks Fei Ke to look after the drunken Xingwen for one more night so nothing goes wrong before everything is finished. Xingwen theatrically recites Shakespeare's speech about life as a stage, alarming Fei Ke into thinking he might run toward the sea. Later, as Fei Ke tends to him, Xingwen asks whether Shakespeare is an incredible writer, leaving Fei Ke struggling to respond.

Lu Xingwen and his contract partner joke about their different backgrounds in Shakespeare and mathematics, and Lu drunkenly marvels that everyone believes their relationship is real. His mood turns bitter as he questions the value of his filmmaking achievements and recalls how Yu Yun pursued him for nearly a year before eventually betraying him for money. Lu asks whom he can still trust, while his partner reassures him that the current troubles will pass in a few months. Lu warns that their planned divorce in three years could subject his partner to intense media scrutiny and blame, but his partner says that is preferable to poverty. They reaffirm their plan to sign the divorce papers after three years and return to their separate lives.

An interview with Fei Ke's university classmates portrays him as a loner who kept his wedding secret, prompting classmates to argue over the unfair treatment in their group chat. During a boat outing, Fei Ke hopes to see dolphins while others discover that Xingwen has donated 20 million dollars to Eastern Star University to renovate its library. Xingwen's agent confronts him for making the donation without consulting the team and suspects he is defending Fei Ke against the negative publicity. Xingwen calls it charity and argues that it will protect Fei Ke's reputation while reinforcing their public image as a loving married couple. The chapter ends with the agent pointing out that both their names will remain on the library permanently, even though they plan to divorce in three years.

Eastern Star University announces a 20 million RMB donation from Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke and congratulates them on their wedding, countering gossip about Fei Ke excluding his former classmates. Fei Ke learns that Lu arranged the donation and public announcement after hearing about the class group chat incident, but an associate warns him not to mistake Lu's lavish spending for special affection. A few days later, during their “honeymoon,” Fei Ke struggles to flesh out his minor character, Kong Pingyi, and hesitates to ask Lu for acting advice. Lu notices and advises him to play the original game behind the adaptation to discover details missing from the script. Fei Ke spends the next few days diligently gaming, leaving Sister Xing incredulous that he has done little else while living with Lu.

Sister Xing suspects that acclaimed actor Lu Xingwen donated 20 million RMB to Lil’ Ke’s alma mater because he is pursuing him, but Lil’ Ke believes Lu is simply sincere and devoted to acting. Lu rehearses with Lil’ Ke, whose performance as Kong Pingyi falters opposite Lu’s powerful acting. Lu criticizes his line delivery and reliance on dubbing, then advises him to understand the character by drawing connections to real people. During a call confirming that Lu’s donation will be paid in one lump sum, Lil’ Ke suddenly understands Kong Pingyi through Lu’s apparently unmotivated generosity. He concludes that Kong Pingyi cares only about martial arts and fine weapons, avoids struggles over status, and gives Gongliang Xingqiu a treasured sword simply because he wants to.

Fei Ke studies Lu Xingwen's early films to improve his acting, beginning with "Gray," in which Lu plays a teenager investigating his best friend's suicide. Awed by Lu's performance but discouraged about his own abilities, Fei Ke learns that Lu prepared by spending two months living as a high school senior, and finds the stories of his dedication and youthful mishaps endearing. After watching Lu's second film, "One Day," which earned him acclaim as the King of Acting, Fei Ke concludes that Lu follows his heart when choosing projects. He connects this insight to his own character, Kong Pingyi, and finishes writing the character's biography. On the last day of vacation, he asks Lu to review it, but their conversation is interrupted by a call from an unknown number: the caller is Yu Yun, much to Fei Ke's surprise.

Yu Yun calls Fei Ke and accuses him of being paid to pose as Lu Xingwen's partner, angrily insisting that Lu should help him despite their breakup a year and a half earlier. Fei Ke declares that he is Lu's legal husband, defends Lu against Yu Yun's accusations, and blocks the number, then panics over whether to tell Lu Xingwen or Feng Jie about the conversation. While studying Kong Pingyi's story, in which he discovers he is the Immortal Blade's spirit and reunites with the sword to help defeat the devil, Fei Ke reflects on his own lack of passion and direction. When Lu returns, he reviews Fei Ke's written character analysis and praises his work, while explaining that Kong Pingyi should be understood as an ordinary teenager pursuing his identity rather than a hero. The chapter ends with Lu encouraging Fei Ke and offering guidance on revisions.

Yu Yun releases a manipulated recording of his phone conversation with Fei Ke, causing online outrage, but Fei Ke insists it is fake. Lu Xingwen's PR team releases the actual conversation, turning public opinion in the couple's favor, while Yu Yun is left abandoned by his company. At Lu Xingwen's studio, an associate warns him against sympathizing with Yu Yun again and suggests that Fei Ke's praise reveals romantic feelings for Lu, which Lu dismisses as ordinary compliments. Embarrassed by the incident, Fei Ke returns to the villa hoping to avoid Lu Xingwen and is relieved to think he is absent, but the chapter ends with a sudden pull and Fei Ke screaming.

Lu Xingwen helps an unnamed aspiring actor understand his acting lessons, then explains that he never mistreated or forced Yu Yun and does not want the controversy to affect their cooperation. He advises the younger man to study films before sending him to rest, but later invites him to have a drink. The younger man initially chooses water because he needs to prepare for an upcoming shoot, while a tipsy Lu admits he is hurt by Yu Yun's repeated betrayals and questions whether he was a bad boyfriend. The younger man awkwardly tries to comfort him, suggesting Yu Yun resorted to damaging public relations tactics rather than acting out of hatred. As the younger man tries to leave, Lu persuades him to try a low-alcohol sparkling wine, and the chapter ends with him taking a sip and remarking that it is sweet.

Brother Feng and Liang Hua arrive at the locked villa and struggle to reach Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke, who drank together the night before, putting Lu's brand event attendance at risk. Brother Feng worries that their fake marriage is becoming real, but Lu admits he finds Fei Ke attractive while insisting that having a crush does not mean he intends to pursue a relationship. Brother Feng eventually consoles himself that genuine love would save them the trouble of a future divorce. Lu and Fei Ke exchange WeChat contacts before Fei Ke starts filming, and Lu offers to answer his questions. Fei Ke notices that Lu still uses a picture of his character Xiaoyu as his profile photo, and the chapter ends with their lighthearted chat about mathematical proofs and Fermat's Last Theorem.

At a luxury watch event, Lu Xingwen affectionately discusses married life with Fei Ke, joking that he cannot understand Fei Ke's talk of Fermat's Last Theorem. Afterward, his university roommate Lin Pei warns that encouraging their shippers could provoke a backlash when they divorce, but Lu pays more attention to a mathematics video. Lin Pei also criticizes Lu's risky film investments, noting that his marriage to Fei Ke helped rescue the box office for "Sword," while Lu dismisses the financial concerns and complains that his educational donation has gone unpraised. Meanwhile, after Fei Ke finishes a photo shoot, Sister Xing asks whether he and Lu get along and have stayed in contact during their two days apart. Fei Ke sincerely describes Lu as kind and sees no need for such frequent contact, surprising Sister Xing because others find Lu difficult; when she mentions Yu Yun's complaints, Fei Ke insists that Yu Yun cannot be trusted.

Fei Ke discovers that Mr. Lu's affectionate interview has put him in the trending topics again and brought him extra attention on set. After Fei Ke earnestly messages him an explanation of Fermat's Last Theorem, Mr. Lu admits he could look it up himself and affectionately calls Fei Ke a good boy, leaving him flustered. Filming begins, but popular young celebrity Kong Weisi arrives late, blaming a delayed flight, while a colleague tells Fei Ke he was actually out partying. Fei Ke hopes to learn from watching him act, but Kong Weisi repeatedly forgets his lines and even recites numbers for later dubbing, dragging out the shoot. Once filming finally ends, Kong Weisi invites the entire cast and crew to supper, prompting the colleague to remark that he is winning people over with food.

Kong Weisi offers snacks to his fellow actors to win favor, while others criticize his poor acting and superficial gestures. During filming, Fei Ke forgets his lines for the first time, apparently stunned by Kong Weisi's awkward performance despite Lu Xingwen's detailed coaching. Kong Weisi resents director Qi Feizhong for insisting he memorize his lines and comparing him unfavorably with Fei Ke. Angry at being told to tolerate Fei Ke because Lu Xingwen supports him, Kong Weisi contacts Fei Ke's former roommate, who insists that Fei Ke and Lu Xingwen's marriage is fake based on its timing and Fei Ke's past behavior. The chapter ends with Kong Weisi questioning whether Lu Xingwen really backs Fei Ke, prompting his companion to warn him against doing anything reckless.

Kong Weisi treats the film crew to expensive catering to draw attention away from Fei Ke’s rising popularity, but Fei Ke enjoys the desserts and dismisses the rivalry. After filming, Lu Xingwen contacts Fei Ke and offers to coach him through his script for an entire month during his break. As they rehearse over the phone, Lu admires Fei Ke’s seriousness and willingness to follow instructions, contrasting him with his former lover Yu Yun. Lu becomes distracted by memories of his two failed relationships, including a first boyfriend who rejected his controlling personality and fetish, and reflects on his desire to avoid repeating his parents’ unhappy relationship. The chapter ends when Fei Ke asks for feedback and Lu admits he was not listening, asking him to read the lines again.

While practicing lines with Mr. Lu, Fei Ke reflects that their transactional relationship has begun to feel like friendship and admits he feels directionless now that he has earned enough money to support his family. Mr. Lu realizes that family responsibilities have kept Fei Ke from considering his own desires, reassures him, and encourages him to discover what he loves while doing his current job well. Later, Mr. Lu leaves a gathering early to tutor Fei Ke, prompting his friends to tease him about missing his husband. When Fei Ke asks to skip practice because filming action scenes has exhausted him, Mr. Lu offers advice and decides to visit the set to help him personally. The chapter ends with Mr. Lu requesting a flight and hanging up on his manager, who is exasperated by his eagerness to visit his fake husband despite agreeing to arrange publicity for the trip.

Mr. Lu heads straight from the airport to Fei Ke's film set, asking his assistant to keep his past secret from Fei Ke and claiming he wants to scare him. He finds Fei Ke resting in a car with bruises from filming fight scenes, checks that his injuries were treated, and insists on staying to watch his work, making Fei Ke nervous. When someone brings afternoon tea from the male lead, Kong Weisi, Mr. Lu answers the door and is mistaken for Fei Ke's assistant. The visitor criticizes his manners, and Mr. Lu suspects they are trying to provoke an incident to generate bad publicity for Fei Ke. After shutting the door and learning who Kong Weisi is, Mr. Lu hears another knock and opens it, ready to confront the visitor again.

Fei Ke receives a cake from Zhang Yuehua, decorated with roses and a poem by Yeats, but assumes it is a mistaken order from Kong Weisi's boyfriend. His nominal husband recognizes the romantic intent, angrily discards the gift, and offers to buy Fei Ke a cake himself. He reminds Fei Ke that they are legally married, warns that Zhang Yuehua is a notorious playboy who pursues young stars, and tells him not to accept further gifts. He then orders assistant Bao Xiaorui to have the delivery person take it back. Bao Xiaorui suggests that Zhang's interest explains Kong Weisi's recent displeasure with Fei Ke, then hurriedly leaves when questioned.

Kong Weisi becomes furious after hearing that Zhang Yuehua sent Fei Ke a cake like his, believing Zhang is pursuing Fei Ke. During filming, Kong repeatedly flubs his lines and blames the difficulty of combining dialogue with action scenes. Lu Xingwen harshly criticizes his lack of preparation, then demonstrates the sword-fighting scene and dialogue himself, impressing onlookers with his portrayal of Gongliang Xingqiu. Lu offers to personally coach Kong, but the director intervenes and calls a twenty-minute break. Privately, the director worries that the publicly humiliated Kong might quit and laments being contractually stuck with an unskilled celebrity.

Lu Xingwen harshly coaches Kong Weisi on set after Kong repeatedly makes Fei Ke reshoot scenes, warning him against deliberately harming others. When Kong calls Zhang Yuehua for help, Zhang admits that Lu has enough industry influence to ruin Kong's career and asks Lu for leniency. Lu orders both men to stay away from Fei Ke, but Zhang reveals knowledge of Lu and Fei Ke's marriage and expected divorce, then suggests Lu let him pursue Fei Ke, infuriating Lu. After more demanding coaching, Kong completes his scene successfully, while Fei Ke receives Lu's praise and invites him to dinner in thanks for his help. Others on set predict that Kong will retaliate through a press release accusing Lu of bullying younger actors, and the chapter closes with a transition to a few days later.

An anonymous post about Lu Xingwen confronting Kong Weisi for bullying Fei Ke on the Xianhua Sect set goes viral, leaving Brother Feng scrambling to control the rumors. Lu defends his intervention and decides to leave Liang Hua with Fei Ke for support. Fei Ke worries about Lu's reputation and explains that he intended to endure Kong's mistreatment so he could focus on filming, having learned from childhood bullying that seeking help rarely changed anything. Lu insists that wrongdoing still matters and asks Fei Ke to tell him whenever he is mistreated, promising to protect him as his partner. Deeply moved by receiving such care despite their contractual relationship, Fei Ke hugs Lu and admits that his shoulders hurt from the exhausting wire work.

Lu Xingwen leaves Liang Hua with Fei Ke to protect him from further trouble with Kong Weisi, and Fei Ke finishes filming two months later. While reviewing job offers, Lu takes an interest in a couples’ reality show with Fei Ke and requests approval of the final edit before broadcast. Knowing Fei Ke needs money for his parents’ housing and his sister’s heart surgery, Lu secretly redistributes their combined fee so Fei Ke will receive six million yuan while preserving his pride. Fei Ke’s manager suspects Lu has romantic intentions and warns him to be careful, though Fei Ke remains oblivious and accepts the job. When Lu returns home, he offers Fei Ke cake and possessively tells him to come home for all the cakes he wants instead of accepting cakes from outsiders with bad intentions.

Over food and sparkling wine, Lu Xingwen asks his younger companion about his schedule and their upcoming reality show. The younger man thanks Lu for helping secure better pay, while Lu brushes it off as ordinary business and teases him when he drinks too quickly and coughs. With Feng Jie and Miao Xin negotiating the contract, the younger man plans to use his fee to buy his family a house and arrange a hospital assessment in Dongming for his sister's possible surgery. After Lu pats his head, he feels flustered and wonders whether to ask about the gesture or thank Lu for financially helping his family. The evening ends with Lu telling him it is bedtime and bidding him good night.

Lu Xingwen visits Fei Ke's younger sister, Lil' Nan, in the hospital and learns that she can have surgery next month, though his interactions with Fei Ke's family remain awkward. Fei Ke's mother worries about the distance between their families and insists that the new home Fei Ke is buying for his family be registered in his own name to keep financial boundaries clear. Before filming the travel reality show "On the Road Together," Lu quietly arranges a makeover for Fei Ke and buys him clothes while pretending they are sponsored. At the airport, Lu initially intimidates the other participants with his silence, but becomes more conversational when Fei Ke joins him, and the two provide affectionate moments for the cameras. After discovering that Fei Ke is reading the source novel for Lu's next film, Lu explains his thorough research for acting roles, prompting Fei Ke to reflect on his own interests; the chapter ends with Lu encouraging him to take his time and follow his passion.

The cast of a couples’ travel variety show arrives in Budapest with prepaid accommodation and 45,000 Hungarian forints each for three days, and Fei Ke recommends a chartered minibus to save money. Fei Ke becomes nervous when he discovers that his room with Lu Xingwen has only one large bed. Lu shows him Feng Jie’s warning that several couples are acting according to scripts, including Mo Yao and Ren Zhiqi, who separated after Ren cheated six months into their marriage. Fei Ke eventually invites Lu off the cramped sofa to share the bed, saying he understands when Lu teases him about inviting a man attracted to men. For their evening Danube sightseeing assignment, Fei Ke proposes economical group travelcards while others prefer a luxury cruise, and Lu leaves their choice to Fei Ke. The chapter ends as they wait for a boat, with Lu buying Fei Ke a hot drink, enjoying his flustered reactions, and calling him a “good boy.”

While traveling through Budapest, Lu Xingwen explains the city's landmarks and tells Fei Ke he will need his help finding their way around. Fei Ke is moved by Lu's apparent sincerity but reminds himself that their romantic dynamic is a public persona for the show. Before the day's mission, the production crew asks the participants to name a famous person associated with Hungary, prompting answers including Princess Sissi, Liszt, and von Neumann. Fei Ke's choice of von Neumann surprises the others and leads to an explanation of his contributions to mathematics and computers. When someone questions his unusual answer, Lu points out that mathematics is Fei Ke's field, and another participant pointedly remarks that their own ignorance makes them look foolish, leaving someone visibly annoyed.

The variety-show teams begin a mission in Budapest at the site of Princess Sissi’s coronation, with correct quiz answers earning 5,000 forints and incorrect answers causing a one-hour delay; Fei Ke lets another team keep their shared ticket. At the second stop, Fisherman’s Castle, the contestants must share a romantic kiss to receive their next mission, and one pair completes the task after the shy younger partner rejects pretending because it would make their relationship look fake. They then witness Ren Zhiqi and his partner arguing bitterly about their behavior during filming, culminating in a slap before he walks away and leaves her crying. Despite his companion’s cynical view of marriage, the younger man goes over to comfort her, and she soon asks the crew to fix her makeup. His companion explains that she has remembered her professional obligations and predicts the couple will resume filming as though nothing happened, then compares their own relationship to the entertainment industry’s pursuit of profit, leaving the younger man visibly unsettled.

After finishing their tour, Fei Ke and Lu Xingwen continue their outing while being filmed. Lu Xingwen asks Fei Ke for pocket money, then leaves briefly to buy him a frozen treat. They share it to save money, and Fei Ke becomes flustered when Lu Xingwen eats the spot he has bitten, wondering whether such intimacy goes too far even for their act. As they read the mission card, they learn that their final mission is at the Széchenyi Chain Bridge and prepare to head there.

Lu Xingwen earnestly promises to take Fei Ke to New Zealand after they discuss places they would like to visit. Their team finishes third in the travel show's challenge despite starting an hour late, earning a hot spring session for two, and Lu Xingwen praises Fei Ke's preparation while helping build his public image as a dedicated actor. During the bath, Fei Ke is so overwhelmed by Lu Xingwen's looks and physique that he can barely speak, prompting Lu Xingwen to end filming early by claiming the cameras make him uncomfortable. Once the crew leaves, Lu Xingwen reassures and teases Fei Ke before leaving the bath first. That night, Fei Ke cannot sleep in a bed scented like Lu Xingwen, reflecting on his own starstruck feelings and wishing he could share the experience with the "Flying on Land" fan forum.

For their final task in Budapest, the couples must buy souvenirs that their partners like. Lu Xingwen gives Fei Ke a postcard featuring a love poem by the Hungarian poet Petofi and explains that he has prepared five gifts, which he plans to mail daily so Fei Ke will receive them after returning home. Fei Ke gives Lu two cans of foie gras after remembering his praise for it at dinner, and Lu warmly accepts them. As the group travels toward Vienna, Fei Ke leaves for the bathroom and encounters another participant, who complains about sharing a room with Ren Zhiqi. The participant asks whether Fei Ke and Lu Xingwen are a fake couple, and Fei Ke emphatically denies it.

Mo Yao warns Lu Xingwen’s young husband that his obvious admiration makes their supposedly long-established romance look unconvincing, and suggests Lu Xingwen is merely acting and toying with his feelings. Shaken, he tells Lu Xingwen that she has seen through their pretense, but Lu reassures him that their marriage is legally real and advises him to respond confidently to probing questions. At their hotel in Vienna, Lu again encourages him to relax during filming and trust Feng Jie’s online publicity team, while the younger man tries to dismiss his growing feelings as excessive immersion in their act. They discuss his sister’s upcoming surgery and his acting and music commitments, and Lu offers to help him choose scripts. The chapter ends with him mortified after Lu discovers his folder of articles about Lu’s acting and physique, then teasingly tells him to ask directly if he wants to know anything.

In Vienna, Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke choose to enjoy their sightseeing at a relaxed pace rather than rush through the itinerary, despite the risk of receiving standing tickets for the concert. When the others worry about affording formalwear, Lu Xingwen reveals that he brought suits for both himself and Fei Ke. They attend a concert at Vienna’s Golden Hall, and Fei Ke reflects that Lu Xingwen’s company has helped him forget the trip’s fatigue and the cameras filming them. Acknowledging that their work will keep them apart after returning home, Lu Xingwen says he will always cherish this moment, while Fei Ke admits he is enjoying his first trip even though it is for work. The chapter ends with the first broadcast of “On the Road Together,” as viewers enthusiastically react to their affectionate interactions, especially Lu Xingwen calling Fei Ke “good boy.”

On the day of his sister’s surgery, Lil’ Ke promises to buy the children game consoles once she leaves the hospital. Lu Xingwen arrives after a long flight and insists on staying to comfort him while he waits, and the surgery succeeds. Later, Sister Xing discusses his growing popularity from their reality show, asks him to choose a film script, and warns him against falling for Lu Xingwen because of his kindness. He privately wonders whether his feelings have become obvious, but admits he has no plans beyond his three-year contract and promises to take his work seriously until it ends. The chapter ends with him deciding he still has time to discover what he wants for his future.

On New Year's Eve, a slightly drunk Lu Xingwen picks up Fei Ke after work and takes him to a quiet hillside, despite paparazzi following them. Lu gives Fei Ke a sports car, but Fei Ke protests that it is too expensive and far exceeds the million dollars promised in their agreement. As midnight fireworks erupt, Lu hugs and spins Fei Ke, then encourages an affectionate display for the watching reporters. The next day, their outing has become trending news, and Lu is challenged about the ten-minute video and his claim that he has no feelings for Fei Ke. Lu admits that he cannot control himself when it comes to Fei Ke.

Lu Xingwen admits he now wants to pursue Fei Ke seriously and asks his team to prepare PR plans for the possible outcomes, confidently dismissing concerns that Fei Ke is straight. Meanwhile, Fei Ke’s manager, Sister Xing, questions him about their kiss and warns him that Lu may exploit their two-year arrangement, but Fei Ke insists his affection is merely admiration for an idol. Later, while talking with Lu about his promotional work, Fei Ke tries to refuse an expensive sports car, worrying about Lu’s spending. Lu reassures him about his wealth and explains that he gives lavish New Year’s gifts to friends, prompting Fei Ke to recall that Yu Yun also received a sports car from him. Fei Ke continues refusing, and Lu finally relents, telling him to buy a car himself when he returns.

Before New Year at the villa, Mr. Lu accompanies his younger companion to buy a new car but worries that he still seems unhappy about the sports car already given to him. After the younger man says he does not like sports cars, houses, or watches as gifts, Mr. Lu presents him with a unique custom necklace from the luxury jewelry brand endorsed by Lu Xingwen, featuring two stacked “Ke” characters. The younger man treasures it so much that he insists on showering and changing before wearing it, and Mr. Lu flusters him by leaning close to smell him. Later, near the sanatorium, Mr. Lu says he wanted to spend New Year's Eve with him and offers to accompany him to see his parents the next day, explaining that his absence would look suspicious. The chapter ends with the younger man reflecting that Mr. Lu has been behaving differently and that they have become much closer.

Director Lin Yuansen asks Lu Xingwen to help cast Xiaohe, a pivotal teenage supporting character in "No. 32, Pu Xi Road." The film follows Li Qi as he investigates his sister’s fatal drug overdose and befriends Xiaohe, whose support steers him away from revenge and helps the police uncover a major drug dealer; Lin and Lu describe the two characters as each other’s salvation. Lu recommends Fei Ke, but Lin initially objects that Lu and Fei Ke’s publicly known relationship could distort the audience’s perception of the characters’ ambiguous bond. Lu secures an audition for Fei Ke and defends his ability despite warnings that his limited experience and the film’s strong cast could expose him to online ridicule. Fei Ke books a flight to arrive the next morning and, despite further warnings about the pressure, decides to try because Lu fought to give him this opportunity.

Fei Ke struggles to understand how to portray the quiet, introspective Xiaohe, so Lu Xingwen takes him to an old suburban apartment for immersive acting training. Lu chose the apartment to experience his character Li Qi's living conditions, while Fei Ke explains that he grew up in similar circumstances and that meeting Lu changed his life. Lu affectionately teases Fei Ke, then privately tells Feng Jie that he likes him but will postpone pursuing him or confessing until filming is over to avoid affecting his performance. Learning that Fei Ke's scenes would take until May if he passes the audition, Lu resigns himself to waiting. The chapter ends with them shopping for household dishes, as Lu explains his plans to live in the apartment while disguising his celebrity identity, and Fei Ke remains puzzled by Lu's increasingly intimate gestures.

Five days later, Fei Ke auditions for Director Lin, with Lu Xingwen acting opposite him. In the scene, Fei Ke plays Xiaohe, a nervous but curious young man who follows Li Qi home and admires his fighting skills, despite Li Qi's efforts to keep him at a distance. Xiaohe explains that his drunken father does not realize what happened to him, then learns that Li Qi used to be a bricklayer. After the performance, Director Lin praises Fei Ke and asks him to explain his understanding of Xiaohe before promising to discuss the results with the scriptwriter. The evaluators agree that Fei Ke conveyed Xiaohe's admiration and desire to understand Li Qi well, and the chapter ends with a meeting being called to decide the casting.

While preparing for his movie role with Mr. Lu at a rental house, Fei Ke becomes livelier and focuses on improving his acting despite online criticism of his casting. Neighbors mistake the two masked actors for potential thieves and report them to the police, whose investigation clears up the misunderstanding but exposes their identities. They return to the villa to avoid further attention, but Mr. Lu notices that Fei Ke becomes withdrawn and behaves like a guest despite having lived there for almost a year. Hoping to make Fei Ke feel at home, Mr. Lu proposes buying a new house and decorating it to Fei Ke's taste. When he asks Feng Jie to find a property, Feng Jie suspects he wants to give it to Fei Ke and bluntly reveals that Mr. Lu is broke.

After hearing that Lu Xingwen's lavish spending and film investment have strained his finances, Fei Ke worries about him. Lu proposes buying or renovating a home to make Fei Ke more comfortable, but Fei Ke still sees himself as a temporary tenant under their fake-marriage arrangement, upsetting Lu. Lu uses the publicity surrounding their reality show as a reason to keep living together, and Fei Ke offers to lend him all sixteen million of his savings, including six million earned from stock trading. The next day, Lu enthusiastically explores selling his downtown apartment to buy a new home, while Sister Xing scolds Fei Ke for lending his hard-earned money to a wealthy star and realizes he is smitten. The chapter ends with the revelation that Lu wants the new property's deed to name them both as equal owners, leaving their handlers worried about dividing it when the fake marriage ends.

In late February, the cast introduces their characters, including Lu's Li Qi, Zeng Kaibin's abusive father Fatty, and Fei Ke's Fang Jiahe, also called Xiaohe, who longs to escape his troubled home. Fei Ke successfully completes his introduction but later grows anxious when Mr. Lu avoids talking to or looking at him during their acting work. Lu nevertheless moves him away from the smokers, joking that secondhand smoke is bad for the child. Fei Ke understands that their characters are strangers, yet realizes how afraid he is of being forgotten by Lu. Unable to sleep at the hotel, Fei Ke goes to get water and encounters Lu, who offers reassuring gestures before asking why Fei Ke always seems so nervous around him.

Lu Xingwen explains the joy of bringing characters to life and encourages Fei Ke to explore acting through his role as Xiaohe, while assuring him that their deal does not oblige him to stay in show business or follow his team's wishes. When Fei Ke belittles his abilities, Lu praises his academic achievements, looks, work ethic, and success in winning a coveted role in Lin Yuansen's film. Lu urges him to take pride in his hard work and admits his own weakness in mathematics to challenge Fei Ke's idealized view of him. As they prepare to say goodnight before the production's opening ceremony, Lu realizes how completely Fei Ke suits his romantic tastes and struggles to restrain his desire. The chapter ends with Lu expressing possessive longing for Fei Ke and asking him to stop calling him “Mr. Lu” and become his “little friend” and “good boy.”

After their fitting, Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke discuss their new hairstyles, and Lu holds Fei Ke's hand as they pass reporters at the hotel. On the first day of filming, Fei Ke struggles through nearly twenty failed takes as Xiaohe, prompting Lu to offer reassurance during a break. Lu explains director Lin Yuansen's demanding methods and encourages Fei Ke to draw on his own memories of worrying about his parents to make Xiaohe's reaction to a family argument more realistic. Fei Ke delivers a successful take and thanks the director and crew for their patience. As Lu takes him home, Fei Ke resolves to work harder on future scenes so he will not disappoint him.

In the dressing room, crew members gossip that Lu Xingwen and Fei Ke's marriage is fake, and Fei Ke stops Xiaorui from confronting them, quietly acknowledging that the rumor is true. During filming, Fei Ke struggles with Lu Xingwen's cold, disgusted gaze before reminding himself that Lu is playing Li Qi, who feels that way toward his character, Xiaohe. Fei Ke succeeds on the second take, and the director praises his performance while recognizing Lu's influence on him. After filming, Lu praises Fei Ke, offers him food as a reward, and explains that he deliberately ignored him to help him enter the scene's emotional state. When Lu asks whether being ignored hurt, Fei Ke privately worries about seeming childish or uncaring, and the chapter ends with Lu affectionately calling him a good kid.

At the hotel, the younger actor finds a note meant for Mr. Lu and becomes jealous, which Mr. Lu quickly notices. Back in their room, Mr. Lu reassures him that he never accepts such notes and asks him to dispose of it himself. A few days later, Lil Ke films a violent scene involving punches and a chair, leaving him sore and bruised. During the break, his companion urges him to get medicine and mentions that Mr. Lu’s experienced assistant, Lixin, has medical supplies ready. The chapter ends with Lil Ke receiving a sweet treat from Mr. Lu as a reward and remarking on how sweet it is.

Fei Ke earns praise for his convincing performance in a frightening scene, but his lingering fear prompts Mr. Lu to check on him. Meanwhile, crew members gossip about makeup artist Tang Tang having passed Mr. Lu a note. Mr. Lu playfully teases Fei Ke about his chocolate reward before asking how he drew out the emotions for the scene. Fei Ke reveals that he recalled his childhood fear of a man his mother dated before marrying his stepfather, though the man never hit him. Mr. Lu reassures him that drawing on genuine feelings is part of acting and nothing to be ashamed of, then affectionately sends him to remove his makeup so they can go home.

In the makeup room, Lu's spouse worries about his bloodied makeup and notices makeup artist Tang Tang getting too familiar with Lu. Lu demands a replacement, says he has been sexually harassed, and points to the surveillance footage as evidence before agreeing to let the matter slide. Back at the hotel, Feng Jie learns that Tang Tang touched Lu's chest and instructs Liang Hua to collect the footage, since a potentially relevant note is already gone. She warns Lu to let her handle such incidents privately because public confrontations can invite malicious rumors online. After the call, Lu tells his spouse to protect himself from harassment and seek help from Lu, his agent, or Feng Jie, stressing that even publicly revealing their marriage would not stop some people.

Lu Xingwen warns his younger companion about powerful investors who exploit actors and promises to protect him. He recounts how an investor harassed him early in his career, had him removed from a role after he resisted, and threatened to blacklist him unless he came to a hotel room to apologize; Feng Jie resolved the crisis by arranging an apology dinner and drinking so heavily that he needed gastric lavage. His companion suggests gaining financial power through a company and film investment, but Lu says he wants to devote his limited energy to acting, leaving the younger man frustrated by their powerlessness. The next day on set, the younger man notices secretive looks and hears people discussing a trending Weibo story. Lu's rival Chen Siyu sarcastically implies that the younger man's career advancement comes from tolerating Lu, prompting him to ask Miao Xin what happened; the chapter ends with her suggesting they talk in the car.

An old university photo of Fei Ke holding hands with his first girlfriend resurfaces online, prompting accusations that he abandoned her to pursue Lu Xingwen for money and status. Fei Ke confirms the relationship was real and worries that the controversy will hurt Lu, while realizing that their publicly claimed wedding anniversary is an invented date. His team identifies Kong Weisi as the source of the attack and suspects Zhang Yuehua is supporting it to undermine Fei Ke’s relationship with Lu. They decide to wait for public attention to fade and postpone the original plan for the couple to live separately after a year, privately reassuring Fei Ke that he can stay with Lu longer. The chapter ends with Lu returning, confirming that the woman was Fei Ke’s first love, and asking permission to pose personal questions that Fei Ke promises to answer truthfully.

Mr. Lu questions the younger man about his first relationship, which lasted only two weeks and ended because his schoolwork and part-time job left his girlfriend feeling neglected. The younger man admits he was unsure whether he liked her romantically and never kissed her, prompting Mr. Lu to explain romantic attraction in terms of wanting physical closeness and kisses. Jealous that he learned about this past relationship through viral news, Mr. Lu teasingly threatens to confiscate the chocolate he gave him and confirms that both his first and second kisses were with Mr. Lu. After kissing him, Mr. Lu acknowledges that what Yu Yun said about him is true, promises he will not hurt him, and asks him to decide whether they should be together once filming ends. The chapter ends with Mr. Lu saying good night and leaving the younger man dazed by his kisses and embrace.

Fei Ke wonders whether his feelings for Lu Xingwen are romantic love or simply admiration for someone he considers out of reach. The next morning, he discovers that Lu publicly defended him on Weibo against people exposing his private life and even acknowledged their anniversary. Touched, Fei Ke makes lunch and brings it to the film set, despite worrying about Lu's dislike of visitors while working. Lu is in an unusually good mood and invites Fei Ke into his van, but Fei Ke repeatedly misunderstands his intentions and tries to leave. When Fei Ke explains that he fears disturbing his work, Lu teasingly asks why he came anyway and ends by threatening to punish him.

The young man visits Mr. Lu at the filming set to thank him for standing up for him, and they share kisses before Mr. Lu reprimands him for disrupting his work. Mr. Lu reminds him that he has until the end of June to consider their relationship and explains that his fetish involves obedience, submission, and punishment for disobedience. He sends the young man back to the hotel and forbids further visits to the set without permission. Back at the hotel, the young man realizes he loves Mr. Lu and researches domination and submission, imagining that he could accept it as role play despite lingering uncertainty about being a slave. Encouraged by Tangtang's apparent acceptance and the example of Mr. Lu's former boyfriend Yu Yun, he convinces himself he can do it too and looks forward to dating Mr. Lu.

Fei Ke struggles to concentrate on his script because he keeps thinking about Lu Xingwen, whose brief visits leave him without a chance to talk. When Fei Ke performs poorly on set, Lin Yuansen calls Lu and mistakenly blames the married couple's intimacy, demanding that they sleep in separate rooms. Lu rushes over and sternly reminds Fei Ke that he must wait until the end of June for the promised answer, obey their agreement, and stop letting his feelings interfere with work. After leaving Fei Ke to reflect, Lu reveals that his harshness was an act intended to put Fei Ke into the sadness and desperation required for his character, Xiaohe. He feels guilty for upsetting Fei Ke and wants to comfort him, but believes this temporary hurt will help him perform.

Miss Xin visits Fei Ke at the hotel to investigate Lu Xingwen's sudden room change, and Fei Ke openly confirms that he loves Lu. She learns that Lu requested separate rooms because Fei Ke's emotional state was affecting his work, but warns Fei Ke to consider whether he can handle Lu's unusual fetish, noting that both of Lu's previous partners initiated their breakups. Over the following days, Lu remains distant, leaving Fei Ke distressed despite understanding that Lu wants him to focus on filming. During an intense scene involving accusations of submission to an abusive father, Fei Ke trembles convincingly without speaking and earns the director's praise. The chapter ends with Lu looking heartbroken, praising Fei Ke's performance, and asking whether he is okay now that filming is finished for the day.

Fei Ke worries that Lu Xingwen has not spoken to him for three days as he prepares for his final and most emotionally demanding scene as Xiaohe. Late that night, Lu invites him to the study and coaches him to draw on buried feelings, sharing his own lonely childhood after his parents’ divorce as an example. The next day, Fei Ke successfully completes the scene, in which Xiaohe desperately tries to save Li Qi, but struggles to leave his character’s emotional state afterward. Lu reassures him that he is there, and Fei Ke asks whether, now that filming is finished, he can give Lu an answer to an earlier unresolved question.

Mr. Lu reassures Fei Ke that he loves and accepts him whether he obeys, acts capriciously, or loses his temper, and the two become a couple in earnest. At dinner, Director Lin reveals that he instructed Fei Ke to keep his distance from his husband for the role, then warns Fei Ke about his difficulty leaving character. Back at the hotel, Mr. Lu tries to help Fei Ke separate himself from Xiaohe, but Fei Ke remains distressed by the character’s loneliness and loss of contact with Li Qi. Mr. Lu arranges for Fei Ke to return to Dongming City the day after tomorrow to choose his next script, explaining that Fei Ke’s presence makes it impossible for him to concentrate on work. When Fei Ke pleads to stay or watch filming, Mr. Lu refuses and ends by questioning whether Fei Ke truly accepts his fetish or is simply complying because of his lingering attachment to Li Qi.

Lu Xingwen tells Fei Ke that he affects him constantly and demonstrates his attraction through an intimate encounter. The next day, Fei Ke returns to Dongming City and faces airport questions about rumors that their relationship has deteriorated and their marriage is fake, while their publicity team plans to use a film press release to address the gossip and generate publicity. Back at Lu's house, Fei Ke begins to feel that he belongs there and notices that Lu is making time to text him even during a filming day. He falls asleep watching one of Lu's films, then wakes to a late-night call in which Lu teases him and encourages him to spend time away from the set to leave his character behind. The chapter ends with Lu falling asleep on the call and Fei Ke softly wishing him good night.

On the ride home, Mr. Lu asks the younger actor to sit close and presses him about whether he has thought through his feelings. The actor recalls an earlier intimate moment in the van, then insists that he is no longer confusing himself and Mr. Lu with their roles as Xiaohe and Li Qi, and that he made up his mind long ago. Mr. Lu pulls him into an embrace and continues being affectionate even after they arrive home, assuring him that Liang Hua and the driver have left. The actor becomes annoyed and jealous over how familiar Liang Hua seems to be with Mr. Lu's habits, and Mr. Lu ends by teasing him that he is even cuter when he is disobedient.

Mr. Lu tells his spouse to shower and come to his room for an exercise introducing his interests. Nervous and self-conscious beside the elegant Mr. Lu, the spouse agrees to a dominant–submissive arrangement, privately feeling unable to give him up. Mr. Lu demands obedience and the title “Master,” then encourages honest communication about likes and dislikes and draws out the spouse’s preferred name, “Puppy.” He orders Puppy to undress, but when Puppy hesitates to follow the instructions fully, he forgives this first lapse and warns that future disobedience will be punished.

Mr. Lu and his boyfriend share an intimate encounter involving master-and-puppy roleplay, with Mr. Lu encouraging him to ask for the affection he wants. His boyfriend shyly requests hugs and kisses, then asks whether he can be Mr. Lu's one and only, promising to behave well. Mr. Lu reassures him that he has always been his only love and emphasizes that they remain equals, even during roleplay. He tells his boyfriend never to sacrifice himself for a partner's attention and to speak up whenever he feels uncomfortable or unhappy. They exchange declarations of love, and his boyfriend reflects on the past year as a dream and his hardships as leading him to Mr. Lu's love.

One year later, Lu wins his third Golden Quill Award and sixth film award overall for "32 Pu Xi Road," publicly thanking his husband, Fei Ke, for his love and support. Asked about his reduced acting workload, Fei Ke says he will soon announce a new career plan. At a gathering in the villa garden, he reveals that Lu took on extra work so Tempest Media would let him focus on his studies, and he has now become a finance postgraduate student at Dongming. Although undecided about quitting acting, Fei Ke hopes to manage Lu's studio finances and investments and eventually establish his own media company. The chapter ends with the couple celebrating together and exchanging declarations of love.

In Fei Ke’s second month of graduate school at Eastern Star University, Lu Xingwen visits before leaving for a three-month film shoot. Fei Ke worries about their separation, and Lu promises to arrange weekend visits while reminding him to prioritize his studies. After an intimate encounter in the car, they share an affectionate goodbye outside Fei Ke’s dormitory. A secretly recorded video sparks rumors that Lu has left Fei Ke for a male student, since Fei Ke’s return to university has not been publicly announced. Following Miss Xin’s advice, Fei Ke posts his student ID on Weibo, revealing that he was the student in the video and prompting fans to tease the couple about their public affection as the comic ends.
